verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The momentum equation matches term by term and sign by sign: navierStokesResidual ν U P_per = ∂_t U + (U·∇)U − ν ΔU + ∇P_per, set equal to F_per = periodize f; ν multiplies only the Laplacian, as in the paper. div U = 0 and U(·,0) = 0 are the other two Lean fields. Two packaging differences. (i) The three clauses are three separate statements rather than one display: navier_stokes_periodize, divergence_free_periodize and periodize_eq_zero_of_timeSlice; of_compact_candidate conjoins all three for the periodized triple as a single CandidateProperties, so the conjunction is stated. (ii) The paper's display leaves the time range to context, while Lean fixes it: the momentum equation on t ∈ Ioo 0 1, the divergence on t ∈ Ico 0 1, the initial condition at t = 0 — which is the range on which the paper's U and P_per are defined by eq-p125-4. navier_stokes_periodize and divergence_free_periodize themselves hold for an arbitrary set `times`, so the restriction is in the packaging, not in the lemmas.
